description: Adversarial Wave 0 on 54 new-and-changed lpn_ keys (calibration report, graphs and reports menu tips, EPS status events, copy-kept notice, menu hotkeys). Each key checked against its call site. No English or $ec_lang_syn changed.

entries.complaint: 'moved to a new place' leaves the subject open, and 'this file' in the second sentence has no clear referent
readings: the file on disk was moved, so this tab is the original opened at its new location and Save overwrites it
the project was moved into a new place (tab, folder) and Save writes to a different file than before
entries.resolution: Kept as written: Tom ruled 'OK.' on this exact text in dev/new-english-keys.md, 2026-10-03; the proposed rewording is withdrawn.

entries.complaint: Row heading in the statistics table whose other rows are location IDs; 'Network' reads as the object (the pipe network) rather than the pooled row

entries.resolution: Kept: 'Network' is EPANET's own word for the pooled row (Tom: OK, 2026-10-03).
